subject: OSS threshold notice — please freeze invoices until VAT ID confirmed
messages:
From: Luc Moreau <luc.moreau@brightway.ai>
To: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: finance@brightway.ai
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 08:12:00 +0100
Subject: OSS threshold triggered in DE — request to pause auto-invoicing

Hi Karthik,

Quick heads up — Brightway just crossed the EU OSS distance-selling threshold for Germany as of last week. Our tax team is asking that Redwood pauses automatic invoice posting/collection for our account while we confirm VAT treatment so we don't get charged incorrectly. We plan to self-account (reverse-charge) for our German customers and need the invoices reissued with our German VAT ID on them.

Can you please freeze any upcoming charges and stop auto-payment attempts while we provide the VAT cert? We'll upload the certificate but wanted to let you know so collections doesn't push through the payment run tomorrow.

Attach: Brightway_VAT_certificate_pending (we will send the official cert within 24 hours)

Thanks — Luc
Luc Moreau
Head of Finance | Brightway AI
luc.moreau@brightway.ai
+33 1 23 45 67 89

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
To: Luc Moreau <luc.moreau@brightway.ai>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:01:00 +0100
Subject: Re: OSS threshold triggered in DE — request to pause auto-invoicing

Hi Luc — thanks for the heads up.

Actioning this now:
- We'll pause the scheduled auto-charge for Brightway's account and mark the upcoming invoices as "on hold" in the billing system.
- To unblock reissue/reversal, please send the German VAT registration certificate (official PDF) and the exact VAT ID to billing. Once we have that we can either reissue invoices with the VAT ID + reverse-charge note or issue credit notes and recreate them depending on the tax team's preference.

Lauren — can you hold the next scheduled charge and create a ticket for reissue once we get the cert? Ben — please pause dunning/automatic retries until we confirm.

Target timeline: hold in place today; expect reissue within 48 business hours after cert received.

Thanks,
Karthik
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Phone: +1 415 555 0123

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 24 Aug 2026 09:22:00 +0100
Subject: HOLD: Brightway AI — pause auto-charge and prepare reissue workflow (BILL-1249)

Team — please action the following for account Brightway AI (customer id 7892):
- Pause any scheduled charges and mark invoices RW-INV-2026-0821-001/002 as "On Hold - VAT evidence pending".
- Stop all retry/dunning sequences until we confirm VAT status.
- Create internal ticket BILL-1249 (linked) to track receipt of VAT cert and reissue steps.
- Once we receive the VAT certificate from client, prepare option A: reissue invoices adding German VAT ID + reverse-charge legend; or option B: issue credit notes and re-create invoices net of VAT as per tax guidance.

I'll pick this up as soon as Karthik confirms receipt of the certificate. Note the client expects action before tomorrow's payment run.

Lauren Bishop

Hi Karthik / Lauren,

Attached is our official German VAT registration certificate and the VAT ID: DE123456789. Please confirm you've received it and that invoices will be reissued under reverse-charge.

Attachment: Brightway_VAT_certificate_DE_123456.pdf (pdf, 285KB)

We prefer reissue (add VAT ID + reverse-charge note) instead of crediting and recreating if that's easier on your side.

Luc

From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 11:03:00 +0100
Subject: Re: OSS threshold triggered in DE — invoices reissued and hold lifted

Hi Luc — thanks for the quick turnaround and for sending the certificate.

We received Brightway_VAT_certificate_DE_123456.pdf and have done the following: 
- Paused scheduled collection for the 24–25 Aug run.
- Reissued RW-INV-2026-0821-001 and RW-INV-2026-0821-002 with the German VAT ID (DE123456789) and a reverse-charge legend on the invoice footnote. PDFs attached: RW-INV-2026-0821-001-reissued.pdf, RW-INV-2026-0821-002-reissued.pdf.
- Marked the billing ticket BILL-1249 as "Resolved — reissue complete" and lifted the hold. Collections will resume on the next manual confirmation from you if you want an additional buffer.

Please confirm you received the reissued PDFs and whether you'd like us to schedule the next collection. If you'd like extra time before we attempt payment, tell us how many days.

Thanks — happy to help make this smooth.

Lauren Bishop
Billing Operations Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
